summary: Backend auth/API regression passed, but frontend E2E matrix is blocked by runtime asset-loading failures (Next chunks 403 + HMR 502) causing missing hydration and preventing completion of requested access/security workflows.

ui_bugs.issue: Brand text is visibly clipped on the left at 390x844.

integration_issues.issue: Critical frontend runtime failure: multiple Next chunk requests return 403 and HMR websocket returns 502, so hydration does not complete. Login submit falls back to native form behavior (URL remains /login?), app-shell/data-app-ready never appears, account splash can remain visible indefinitely.

integration_issues.flow: Navigation stress 8x fresh loads + immediate/forced click comparison
integration_issues.issue: Could not complete intended matrix because first stress run already blocks at login/hydration stage due runtime asset failures; nav flakiness cannot be reliably re-validated until chunk delivery is fixed.

issues: Left-side logo clipping persists while right overflow is not present.

action_items: HIGH: Fix Next dev asset delivery on preview (403 for /_next/static/chunks/* and HMR 502). Without this, hydration and most UI/integration tests are invalid.
Fix origin/dev-host configuration (allowedDevOrigins / ingress host alignment) so preview host can load all Next resources.

After runtime fix, rerun required matrix: 04-secret-create, 09-file-key, 99-settings-nav-stress (>=8 fresh loads + immediate/forced click evidence), then continue full access workflows requested in review.
Fix mobile login brand clipping on the left at 390x844 after hydration issue is resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: Runtime infrastructure issue dominates functional quality: app frequently serves HTML but blocks essential JS chunks (403), making authentication/navigation behavior appear flaky while actually non-hydrated.
Test adjustments were limited to reliability improvements only (splash/app-ready waits, stricter lock selectors, env-only stress config). No business logic or crypto/access policy changed.

Backend scaffold process is non-authoritative for this app and shows import failure in supervisor logs, but requested public auth endpoints used by app are responding and backend regression tests passed.

success_rate.frontend: 20% (login page render + evidence capture only; critical runtime blocker prevented full requested matrix)

seed_data_creation: Disposable backend test user visual_access_test_* and one temporary license key were created by pytest and cleaned in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Recreated missing log at /app/test_reports/access-existing-e2e.log. Requested e2e specs (04/09/99) were rerun after minimal test-only fixes, but frontend remains blocked by chunk 403/hydration failures. Unit suite for crypto/lock/onboarding/backup passed and typecheck passes. Resume from runtime fix first, then rerun full access matrix in fresh contexts.
rca of the issue: Repro: open preview URL /login or run Playwright 04/09/99; on submit or root load, many /_next/static/chunks/* requests fail 403 and _next/hmr websocket fails 502. Result: React hydration incomplete, login may degrade to native GET (/login?), app-shell readiness signal absent, account splash may remain. Mitigation: align preview ingress/dev host with Next allowedDevOrigins and ensure static chunk/HMR paths are allowed for the public preview origin before retesting feature flows.
